about.title: About La gourde isotherme
about.meta: Who we are, editorial method, independence, and transparency on Amazon affiliates and AdSense.
about.lead: La gourde isotherme is an independent editorial site focused on insulated bottles, mugs and tumblers. Our goal is to help you choose with clear information — not to sell in your place.
about.missionBody: Make the criteria that matter accessible (volume, insulation, lid, care, leak-proofing) and map them to real use cases: sport, desk, travel. We prefer explanation and comparison over marketing slogans.
about.methodBody: We build pages from public specs, usage feedback and Amazon bestsellers (Ships and sold by Amazon when possible).
about.method1: Structured sheets: strengths / limits and use cases.
about.method2: Practical guides: choosing, care, bottle vs tumbler.
about.method3: Comparisons: decide between models or formats.
about.method4: Transparency: every affiliate purchase link and every ad is identifiable.
about.independenceBody: This site is not operated by the cited brands or Amazon. Brands belong to their owners. Our copy is written for readers; an affiliate link does not change the price you pay.
